answer: Because the timing is recorded against the nadir challenge, the nectar audit can replay the dawn history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 170 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
